notes: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Hidden flags, missable flags, roadmap stages, categories and counts are this guide's own annotations. Every guide text below is written for this guide.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task: work through the roadmap stages in order, save the long grinds for last, and this one unlocks itself at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is mostly a guided intro: follow the on-screen prompts, drive where the marker points, and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends with a clear cutscene and a chapter card, so you will know when it is done. Use this chapter to learn the map and stock up on ammo before things get harder.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Missions here introduce the drug-trade side of Leonida, so expect more driving and more shootouts. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you want to replay a mission for a better approach.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the Vice City stretch: neon, beaches and bigger set pieces. By now you should have a favourite car and weapon loadout; stick with them and the chapter flows quickly.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The stakes and the firefights both climb here, so use cover, use Combat Focus, and do not rush open ground. The trophy lands as soon as the final Chapter 4 mission wraps.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is a long one, so go in with full armour and a full ammo stock, and save beforehand. Gold for beating the story; after the credits, the open world stays available for cleanup.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission that appears as you progress, so just keep playing the main path and take it when the marker shows up. A fast car helps, since the mission is mostly a timed drive.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Plan the approach the game offers you, bring heavy weapons for the escape, and keep your getaway vehicle close to the exit. The trophy unlocks when the crew gets clear.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. This one leans on stealth and timing rather than firepower, so move slowly, watch the patrols, and only go loud when the mission forces it.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Expect a big public set piece with a lot of moving parts: follow the mission markers, stay with your partner, and use the chaos as cover to reach the objective.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Airport security is dense, so pick off guards quietly where you can and save the loud approach for the runway section, where stealth stops mattering.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the heaviest combat missions in the game, so stock armour, bring a rifle with a scope, and clear rooftops before advancing on foot.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game stats screen. That means every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and area explored. Track the percentage in the pause menu and clean up the lowest categories first; the last few percent are almost always collectibles.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, long airtime and close calls all count. The fastest way is a fast bike on the highway, weaving through traffic for near misses, plus the marked stunt jumps around the city. It builds up passively if you drive aggressively, so start early and let it tick over.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, bowling, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, meditation, hunting and the card game are the set to work through. Open the activities tab in the pause menu and tick them off one by one; none of them needs a win, just a try.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go for accuracy over speed: short controlled bursts, aim for the head targets first, and replay a challenge immediately when you miss gold, while the layout is still fresh in your mind. The pistol challenges are the easiest golds, so bank those first.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates before racing hard: fly one slow practice lap, note the tight turns, then race for the win. The beach and downtown courses are the trickiest, so save them until you are comfortable with the drone handling.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida. Mix street races, off-road races and boat races so you are not stuck on one type. Upgrade a car per class rather than one car for everything, and replay a race you lost right away while you remember the corners.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension: reel steadily when the fish runs away from you and ease off when the line goes red. Cal fishes cleanly but slowly, so a patient reel beats a frantic one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at any arcade cabinet. Pick a short one, learn its one core mechanic in the first minute, and finish the run; you do not need a high score, just a completed game.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission by completing his whole strand. Andy's missions unlock gradually as the story advances, so check the map for his marker after each chapter and clear his jobs before moving on.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission by completing his whole strand. Kenton's jobs are boat and smuggling work, so keep a fast boat handy and do his missions as soon as they appear to avoid a backlog at the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission by completing his whole strand. Billy's jobs are out in the rural north, so plan for long drives and bring a sturdy off-road vehicle for the rough tracks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Strangers appear as question marks on the map; each strand is several missions long. Do not leave them all to the post-game: pick up a strand whenever you pass its marker, because some strands only unlock while the story is still running.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission by completing his whole strand. Randy's jobs pay well and get messy, so bring armour and a getaway plan for every one of his missions, especially the last.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission by completing his whole strand. Tyrone's missions are city-based and combat heavy; a silenced pistol helps in the early ones, and the finale rewards going in loud and fast.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The spots are scenic viewpoints, beaches and hilltops marked once you are near them. Visit them during quiet moments between missions; each session is short, and the game logs the spot as soon as the meditation completes.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow the tracks and clues Bret gives you rather than wandering: the trail leads to a den, and the animal appears there at a set time of day. Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind so it does not bolt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Card packs are sold in shops and found in the world; buy every pack you see and trade duplicates. Start with the smallest sets first so you bank a completed set early and keep momentum.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The app flags photo-worthy spots as you explore, so open it whenever the prompt appears and snap the shot. City landmarks cluster together, so a walking tour of Vice City beach and downtown knocks out a big chunk in one session.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, and they tick over during normal play. Check the challenges tab regularly and steer your sessions toward the ones nearly done; the first 50 come fast if you vary what you do.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Get the heat in a quiet area, then drive to the countryside or into a tunnel and stay out of sight until the stars clear. Do it during a story mission that already has your partner with you, so the setup is free.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together on the same street, hit them in quick succession, and keep the wanted level alive by staying visible to the police between robberies. A fast car parked outside each shop is essential.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by driving or entering new models. Every new model you sit in counts, so hop into anything unusual you see parked: trucks, bikes, boats and rare cars all count. The vehicle list in the pause menu shows what you have found and what is left.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a mission with a packed room, let the enemies group up, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them quickly with headshots. If you run out of targets, reload the checkpoint and try again in the same spot.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA airport, take a plane and leave without clearance: steal a plane from the runway area and take off while the airport is on alert. A small fast plane is easiest to get airborne before security closes in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos, the army tanks that roll in at high wanted levels. The practical approach is to get to 5 stars in an open area, then use sticky bombs or a rocket launcher from behind cover, because a Rhino's front armour soaks up small-arms fire. Keep moving so its cannon cannot track you.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at night, enter quietly, avoid the cameras and the guard's line of sight, and leave before the alarm trips. If a guard spots you, reload the checkpoint and try a slower route; patience is the whole trick here.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big planned robberies: scout the bank, bring a fast getaway car, and do not linger after the vault opens, because the response escalates fast. Space them out between other work so the heat never stacks.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around the city; ram one to a stop or block it with your car, grab the cash, and break line of sight before the police close in. A bike is the best getaway because it threads traffic.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, so drive every highway, visit every town, and fly or boat to the islands and the swamps. Check the areas list in the pause menu for the blank spots, then route a road trip through them in one session.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own racket somewhere in the state, marked once you have scouted it. Hit one per gang, one at a time, and expect a fight at every site, so go in armed and with an exit route planned.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a beach bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: sit down, take in the sunset over the water, and the trophy pops once the drink scene plays out. Best done at dusk for the full effect.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street. Pick a showroom with a clear exit and a fast car, and do not stop until you are out on the road.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game with proper follow-through. It is a short activity: aim carefully, keep your throws consistent, and the trophy unlocks when the game ends, whatever your score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership moment with mass appeal: a scene where you and your partner pull something off in front of a crowd. It comes from a specific story beat, so keep playing the main path and it will arrive on its own; there is nothing to grind for it.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game. Choices include dialogue options, mission decisions and small world interactions, and they add up over a full playthrough. Pick actively instead of skipping dialogue and you will be most of the way there by the finale; the rest come from free-roam interactions.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. This one is almost accidental: fail a mission or an activity once, then pass it immediately afterwards. If it has not popped by the end of the story, replay any mission you once failed and pass it on the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strangest sights: a random world event that feels out of place. These events appear at set spots and times, often at night in remote areas. Roam the swamps and the desert roads after dark and keep an eye out for anything that does not belong.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: drive past a pedestrian slowly and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. A slow car on a quiet street works best, and a bat or similar weapon has the reach you need. One clean hit is all it takes.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to your laundering contacts over time rather than all at once. It pairs naturally with the bank vault and armored truck robberies, so do those first and launder the proceeds.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops: clothes, weapons, car upgrades and food all count. It adds up fast if you buy weapon attachments and car mods during the story, so do not hold back on upgrades and the total will take care of itself.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Each one costs a different amount, so save up and buy them as you can afford them. Garages also store your vehicles, so buy the ones near your favourite areas first and the rest as money comes in.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, photograph or scan a vehicle, and register it. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, so register every new car you drive and the trophy pops quickly.
trophies.name: On the Spot
